~4 hours (10 missions; can be done in stages)

{npc:Kevin} runs the Tibia Postal Service and only accepts postmen who prove their worth. You do 10 mail missions all over Tibia, rising from Assistant Postman to Arch Postman. You get cheaper letters and parcels, boat discounts, the {item:Post Officer's Hat}, the {item:Post Horn}, access to the royal mailboxes and the achievement **Archpostman**.
It is very hard to become a postman, so Kevin has a five-stage course: Assistant Postman, Postman, Grand Postman, Grand Postman for Special Operations and Arch Postman.

When you reach **Assistant Postman** (end of mission 2).

Shortcut in mission 6 of The Thieves Guild Quest
With the **Arch Postman** rank and the {item:Post Officer's Hat} on your head, you receive the key for mission 6 (Fishnapping) without bribes.
The wiki mentions a 6k discount on that quest.
The quest is almost entirely on foot along safe paths: bring plenty of food ({item:Brown Mushroom} is the best).
If you forget where you have to go, check the quest log or say {key:mission} to Kevin.
After every second mission, ask Kevin for {key:advancement} to rank up.
Joining Kevin's guild does not stop you from being in a normal Tibia guild.
Kevin sends you to test four travel routes. You have to make the trips with the NPCs listed.
Join the guild and ask for the mission
Go to {npc:Kevin}'s post office, between Thais and Kazordoon. Say {key:hi}, {key:mission} and answer {key:yes} to all the questions (7 times). He explains the four trips you have to make.
Go to **Thais** and take {npc:Captain Bluebear}'s boat to **Carlin** (110 gp).
Carpet from Femor Hills to Edron
Walk to the **Femor Hills** and talk to {npc:Uzon} to fly by carpet to **Edron** (60 gp). The ramp to reach Uzon is at the marked spot.
In Edron you can already buy the {item:Crowbar} for mission 2 from {npc:Beatrice} (260 gp).
In Edron, take {npc:Captain Seahorse}'s boat to **Venore** (40 gp).
Steam Boat from Kazordoon to Cormaya

Walk to **Kazordoon** and, in the deepest cave, travel on {npc:Brodrosch}'s {wiki:Steam Boat} to **Cormaya** (160 gp). Alternative: go back to Edron, go to Cormaya and make the trip from Cormaya to Kazordoon and back. The way to the boat goes through the mines (bats, {creature:Rotworm|Rotworms}, {creature:Dwarf|Dwarves} and {creature:Dwarf Soldier|Dwarf Soldiers}): follow the maps. Alternatively, buy a ticket for the {wiki:Ore Wagon|Ore Wagon} and ride the wagon (from the depot, the temple, the main entrance or the shops) straight to the boat.
Way to the Kazordoon Steam Boat — map 1
Way to the Kazordoon Steam Boat — map 2

Return to {npc:Kevin}'s post office. The cheapest way is on foot through the {creature:Rotworm|Rotworms} caves to Edron, boat to Venore and then on foot to Kevin. Say {key:hi} and {key:mission} to hand in.
Say {key:mission} and {key:yes} to {npc:Kevin}. A mailbox on the island of **Folda** is stuck and you have to fix it with a {item:Crowbar}.
Buy a {item:Crowbar} if you don't have one yet. It is on sale in Edron, Darashia, Kazordoon, Venore and north of Thais (from {npc:Lubo}).
Go to the boatman **northwest of Carlin** ({npc:Nielson}) and take the raft to **Folda** (20 gp). Say {key:hi}, {key:folda}, {key:yes}. You disembark at the Folda docks, next to {npc:Svenson}.
Boatman to Folda, northwest of Carlin
Climb to the top of the Folda mountain and use the {item:Crowbar} on the mailbox.
Mailbox at the top of the Folda mountain

Come down the mountain the same way and go back to the Folda docks. Say {key:hi}, {key:tibia}, {key:yes} to {npc:Svenson}: the trip from an island to the mainland is free and drops you northwest of Carlin. From there, go back to {npc:Kevin}.
Go back to {npc:Kevin} and say {key:mission} and {key:yes}. He gives you the title of **Assistant Postofficer**: from now on all postmen charge you less. If needed, also ask for {key:advancement}.

Continue the conversation with {npc:Kevin} and say {key:yes} when he asks if you are ready. You receive a {item:Bill} (for a magician's hat and some rabbits) to deliver to the magician David Brassacres, hiding in Venore.
Do not go on without having the {item:Bill} in your inventory.
Go to **Venore** and look for {npc:A Strange Fellow} underneath the depot.
A Strange Fellow, underneath the Venore depot
Say {key:hi} and then {key:hat} **4 times** until he admits he is David Brassacres. Then say {key:bill} and {key:yes}.
Bring the 20 {item:Bone|Bones} with you already: you will hand them in on the next mission.
Say {key:mission} and {key:yes} to {npc:Kevin}. The postmen are having trouble with aggressive dogs and the bone fund is running out: you need 20 {item:Bone|Bones}.

Gather 20 {item:Bone|Bones}. The easiest way is to go to **Mount Sternum** and kill {creature:Skeleton|Skeletons}. {wiki:Mount Sternum} is **northeast of Thais**, southwest of Kazordoon ({coord:32494,32072,7}). When you have the bones, leave the same way you came in and go back to the post office.
Each bone weighs 9.50 oz: the 20 weigh 190 oz. Make sure you have enough capacity.

Go back to {npc:Kevin} and say {key:mission}. If you have all 20, say {key:all} and {key:yes}. If you can't carry them all at once, answer {key:yes} and he accepts them one by one (repeat {key:mission} when you have more).
Say {key:mission}, {key:yes}, then {key:advancement} and {key:yes}. You become a **Postman** and receive your {item:Post Officer's Hat}.
Say {key:mission} and {key:yes} to {npc:Kevin}. You have to deliver a present to {npc:Dermot}, in Fibula.
In Kevin's room, open the flashing door on the **lower right** and take the {item:Present (Postman)|present} from the chest.

**DO NOT OPEN THE PRESENT!** If you try to open it you get nothing and the present disappears. You would have to buy another one from {npc:Black Bert} for 16,000 gp or fetch one with another character.

Travel to **Fibula** and talk to {npc:Dermot}: {key:hi}, {key:present}, {key:yes}. To get to Fibula from **Thais**, go through the {wiki:Fibula Tunnel} ({coord:32261,32385,7}), southwest of the city, or use the teleport on the 2nd floor of the {wiki:Knightwatch Tower}. Dermot is in the **west** part of the village. To come back, take the same way through the tunnel.
The longest mission (about 1 hour): you travel between Venore, Kazordoon, Carlin and Thais to create the new uniforms. Bring the {item:Mouldy Cheese}, the {item:Banana Skin} and the {item:Dirty Fur}.
Say {key:mission} and {key:yes} to {npc:Kevin}. He sends you to negotiate a uniform contract with {npc:Hugo}, in Venore.

Go to **Venore**, to the clothes shop, and go up to the upper floor. Say to {npc:Hugo}: {key:hi}, {key:new set of uniforms}, {key:new dress pattern}. He doesn't know where the pattern came from and sends you to ask Kevin.
Hugo, upper floor of the clothes shop
Go back to {npc:Kevin} and say {key:new dress pattern}. He sends you to ask the great technomancer of Kazordoon for the technical details.

Go to **Kazordoon**. On the {creature:Rat|rats} floor, go to the west end of the passage west of the shops. Go down **two stairs** and head **north** to {npc:Talphion}. He is deaf: say {key:new dress patterns} about 5 times until he understands and sends a copy to Kevin.
Kevin sends you to the queen
Go back to {npc:Kevin} and say {key:new dress pattern}. Now you have to ask {npc:Queen Eloise} for the colours.
Go to **Carlin** and talk to {npc:Queen Eloise}: say {key:hail queen eloise} and then {key:uniforms}. She sends colour samples to Kevin.
Go back to {npc:Kevin} and say {key:new dress pattern} and {key:yes}. The uniforms must have a smell that dogs hate, and {npc:Noodles}, {npc:King Tibianus}'s dog, is the best judge of that.
Gather a {item:Mouldy Cheese}, a {item:Banana Skin} and a {item:Dirty Fur} (one of each is enough for the whole group).

Go to the **Thais** castle and talk to {npc:Noodles}. Say {key:hi}, {key:sniff banana skin}, {key:do you like that?}. Then repeat with {key:sniff dirty fur} and {key:sniff moldy cheese} (saying {key:hi} again if needed) until Noodles spits. It can happen right away with the first item.
Sometimes Noodles reacts in a different way. Check the quest log to confirm whether it is done; if not, keep trying.
Go back to {npc:Kevin} and say {key:new dress pattern}. He sends the pattern to Hugo and asks you to tell him that they are ordering the uniforms.
Go to {npc:Hugo} in Venore again and say {key:new dress pattern}. He insults the pattern but agrees to make the uniforms.
Go back to {npc:Kevin} and say {key:mission}, {key:advancement} and {key:yes}. You become a **Grand Postman**.
7. Mission 7 — Measurements (Grand Postman for Special Operations)

Say {key:mission} to {npc:Kevin}. Hugo needs the measurements of six postmen: Ben, Lokur, Dove, Liane, Chrystal and Olrik. You can collect them in any order; to all of them you say {key:hi} and {key:measurements}.
Dice game: 5 gp per throw until a 6 comes up
Kazordoon, north end of the depot {coord:32648,31906,8}
Sends you to {npc:Kroox} {coord:32652,31889,9}: say {key:Lokurs measurements} to him
Walk to **Thais** and say to {npc:Benjamin}, in the depot: {key:hi}, {key:measurements}. He tells a confusing story and at the end gives you the measurements.
Take the boat to **Carlin** (100 gp). Buy 12 {item:Arrow|Arrows} from {npc:Perac} and say to {npc:Liane}, in the depot: {key:hi}, {key:measurements}, {key:yes}.

Walk to **Ab'Dendriel** and talk to {npc:Olrik}, southwest of the depot: {key:hi}, {key:measurements}, {key:yes}. He rolls a die: if a 6 comes up you win and he tells you the measurements; otherwise you lose 5 gp. Keep saying {key:yes} until you win.
Olrik, southwest of the Ab'Dendriel depot
It can take several attempts. Bring about 200 gp.
Walk to **Kazordoon**. Say to {npc:Lokur}, at the north end of the depot: {key:hi}, {key:measurements}. He sends you to his armourer, {npc:Kroox}: say {key:hi} and {key:Lokurs measurements} to him.
Go up to the top of Kazordoon to {npc:Gewen} and take the carpet to **Edron** (30 gp). Say to {npc:Chrystal}, above the depot: {key:hi}, {key:measurements}.
Take the boat to **Venore** (30 gp). Buy {item:Grapes} from {npc:Rodney} (3 gp) and say to {npc:Dove}, in the depot basement: {key:hi}, {key:measurements}, {key:yes}.
Walk to {npc:Kevin} and say {key:mission} to hand in the measurements.
8. Mission 8 — Missing Courier (Grand Postman for Special Operations)

Say {key:mission}, {key:yes} and {key:yes} to {npc:Kevin}. The messenger Waldo disappeared while looking for an underground passage in the troll mountain east of Thais. You have to find his body or at least his horn.
You can only open Waldo's door **after** Kevin gives you this mission.
Go to the {wiki:Thais Troll Caves|Thais Troll Caves} and use the {item:Shovel} to open the entrance hole.
Inside, go **east** and go down through the hole. Then head **north** and **east**, go past the {creature:Orc|Orcs} and go up the stairs.
Waldo is just to the **west**, behind a {item:Door (Sealed)|sealed door}. Use his body to receive the {item:Waldos Posthorn}.
Waldo's body, with the Waldos Posthorn
If you don't have the 500 oz of free capacity for the next mission, buy a {item:Parcel} from {npc:Wally} and send yourself whatever you don't need.

With the horn, go back the same way: return to the stairs (east of Waldo) and go down them, then head back **west** and **south** (past the {creature:Orc|Orcs}) to the hole you came down through and climb up it with the {item:Rope}. Then head **west** again to the entrance hole and climb up again with the Rope to the surface, east of Thais.
Go back to {npc:Kevin} with the horn. Say {key:mission}, {key:yes}, {key:yes}, {key:advancement} and {key:yes}. You receive your {item:Post Horn}.
Say {key:mission} and {key:yes} to {npc:Kevin}. You have to take a bag of letters to Santa Claus, on the island of **Vega**.
In Kevin's room, open the sealed door on the **lower left** and take the {item:Letterbag} from the chest.
The Letterbag weighs **500 oz**. The chest only lets you take it out if you have that capacity free.

Go to {npc:Nielson}, northwest of Carlin, and take the raft to **Vega**. Head **west** to Santa's house. Say to him {key:hi}, {key:vega}, {key:yes} (20 gp). You land in the **east** of Vega, next to {npc:Carlson}'s raft.
Nielson (raft to Vega, northwest of Carlin)
If you lose the Letterbag, you can buy another one from {npc:Black Bert} for 8,000 gp.
Use the {item:Letterbag} on the {item:Santa's Mailbox} (this mailbox is not for normal mail). Once the letters are delivered, the bag turns into a normal {item:Red Bag}.
Go back **east** to {npc:Carlson}'s raft and say {key:hi}, {key:tibia}, {key:yes}: the trip from an island to the mainland is free and drops you northwest of Carlin.
Return to {npc:Kevin} and say {key:mission} for the last mission.
Say {key:mission} and {key:yes} to {npc:Kevin}. You receive a {item:Letter to Markwin|letter} from the mother of {npc:Markwin}, the king of Mintwallin.
Go to the **Ancient Temple** of Thais and follow the {wiki:Route:Mintwallin|route to Mintwallin}, the minotaur city, to {npc:Markwin}'s castle. The following steps describe the route step by step.
Thais Ancient Temple (start of the route)
There are many minotaurs along the way ({creature:Minotaur}, {creature:Minotaur Archer}, {creature:Minotaur Guard}, {creature:Minotaur Mage}).

At the Ancient Temple, north of Thais, go down **two floors** and go as far **north** as you can. Go down to the {creature:Rotworm|Rotworms} floor, follow the path **east** and then **south** and go down the stairs.
This floor has many poison fields: run through them and cure the poison afterwards, or clear a path with {item:Destroy Field Rune|Destroy Field}. Then go down one more floor.

Follow the path **east** and **north**, careful with the {creature:Minotaur|Minotaurs}, and go down the hole marked on the map: 2 {creature:Cyclops|Cyclopes} are waiting for you down there. After you kill them, follow the blue line on the maps, from A to B; there are no more monsters on this stretch (maybe a {creature:Rat}).
When you reach the two stairs, go down either one and walk a few steps **west**: you are at the gate of Mintwallin. {npc:Markwin}'s castle is further ahead, inside the city.

Before saying {key:hi}, use the spell {spell:Invisible} or a {item:Stealth Ring}. The **first time** you say {key:hi}, he summons 8 bodyguards: 4 {creature:Minotaur Archer|Minotaur Archers}, 2 {creature:Minotaur Guard|Minotaur Guards} and 2 {creature:Minotaur Mage|Minotaur Mages}. Kill them or ignore them. You can also say {key:hi} from outside the castle to lure them a few at a time.
No Stealth Ring and only just above level 30? Push Markwin to the right with furniture and talk to him through the level 30 door: that way the bodyguards don't appear.

Go back the same route to the Ancient Temple (use the {item:Rope} on the holes you came down through). On the way back there is a shortcut: follow the **red** line on the route maps to a hole with 2 {creature:Bonelord|Bonelords}, go down it and continue along the **blue** line to the exit. That hole is down-only: there is no spot for the rope, so it can't be used to go back to Mintwallin.
Go back to {npc:Kevin} and say {key:mission}, {key:advancement} and {key:yes}. You become an **Arch Postman**, can use the real mailboxes in dangerous areas and earn the achievement **Archpostman**.
The list of real mailboxes is on the {wiki:Mailbox|Mailbox} page of TibiaWiki.
If you lose the present from mission 5 or the Letterbag from mission 9, {npc:Black Bert} sells replacements (16,000 gp and 8,000 gp).
